questions.q: What did Willink do when his team was stuck on the oil rig?
a: He stepped away to get a wider view of the situation
He ordered the whole team to retreat
He called headquarters for new orders
He split the team into two smaller groups
questions.why: Lesson 1 says separating himself let him see the big picture.

questions.q: Why does stepping back help you make better decisions?
a: The pause releases emotions that cloud your judgment
It gives others time to finish their work
It shows your team that you are calm
It lets you avoid responsibility for the outcome
questions.why: Lesson 1 says strong feelings get in the way of good decisions.

questions.q: What does picking up brass represent in the summary?
a: A leader doing menial work alongside the team
A punishment for soldiers who disobey orders
A ritual performed before every mission
A reward given to top performers
questions.why: Lesson 2 says humility improves unity and trust.

questions.q: How should a leader give praise?
a: Be specific and connect it to the larger goal
Save it for the annual performance review
Keep it general so no one feels left out
Give it only in private conversations
questions.why: Lesson 3 says specific praise naming the exact contribution works better.

questions.q: What should a leader do first when someone disobeys?
a: Ask how they could have explained the task better
Issue a formal warning immediately
Reassign the person to another team
Ignore it and move on to other work
questions.why: Lesson 3 calls this practicing Extreme Ownership.
